INCIDENT
id: incident-02a-standard-001
At 09:40, an operator reports a broad customer-facing degradation.
The visible symptom is on commerce-gateway; that service may be downstream of the cause.

TOPOLOGY
commerce-gateway -> checkout-api
checkout-api -> fraud-service
checkout-api -> orders-postgres
checkout-api -> orders-redis
checkout-api -> bank-gateway
order-worker -> order-events
order-consumer -> orders-postgres
COMPONENTS
app: checkout-api
auth: fraud-service
cache: orders-redis
cert: bank-gateway
consumer: order-consumer
db: orders-postgres
dns: platform-dns
external: bank-gateway
gateway: commerce-gateway
queue: order-events
worker: order-worker

RECENT CHANGES
09:50 commerce-gateway deployment/configuration revision r70 became active
09:42 the incident signal predates this latest change; incident declared at 10:48

METRICS
M1 database connection wait p95: 35 ms -> 2.8 s
M2 commerce-gateway error/latency signal: baseline -> elevated
M3 orders-postgres dependency health: requests queue while database CPU remains below saturation
M4 commerce-gateway health probe: stable at 200 ms

LOGS / EVENTS
E1 orders-postgres: timed out after 2000 ms waiting for an available database connection
E2 commerce-gateway: upstream request deadline exceeded after the first symptom
E3 commerce-gateway: no corresponding error spike

ALERTS / DEPENDENCY HEALTH
A1 orders-postgres: connection acquisition time crossed the service threshold
A2 orders-redis and bank-gateway: health checks normal
